scope: Repeatable static roast gates; a passing check proves only the narrow property described.

checks.title: Formal execution-plan validation
checks.remediation: Validate bounds, identifiers, dependency references, duplicates, and cycles before a run starts.

checks.title: Public-network egress guard
checks.remediation: Resolve and validate every destination and redirect; block private, loopback, link-local, and metadata networks.

checks.title: Least-privilege default tool set
checks.remediation: New agents must receive an explicit minimal tool allowlist, never every registered tool.

checks.title: Plan deadlock cannot become success
checks.remediation: Fail or block the run when no step is ready while unfinished steps remain.

checks.title: Tool-loop exhaustion cannot become success
checks.remediation: Mark the step failed when the model still requests tools after the iteration budget is exhausted.

checks.title: Run admission control
checks.remediation: Bound global and per-user active runs and expose backpressure rather than allowing unbounded fan-out.

checks.title: Skill ownership enforcement
checks.remediation: Only built-in or user-owned skills may be read or attached to an agent.

checks.title: Administrative policy mutation
checks.remediation: Require an explicit administrative role for shared policy mutation.

checks.title: Audit log access restriction
checks.remediation: Restrict audit event access to authorized administrative or tenant-scoped principals.

checks.title: Database migration fail-closed
checks.remediation: Abort startup when required migrations fail.

checks.title: Provider enabled flag enforced
checks.remediation: A disabled provider must be ineligible for dispatch and test calls.

checks.title: Artifact size bound
checks.remediation: Reject or stream artifacts above the documented limit.

checks.title: Baseline browser security headers
checks.remediation: Set baseline browser security headers on all application routes.

checks.title: Content Security Policy
checks.remediation: Add a tested CSP compatible with Next.js and the selected UI runtime.

checks.title: Durable workflow worker
checks.remediation: Persist run leases, checkpoints, retries, cancellation, and resume state outside process memory.

checks.title: Idempotency keys for side effects
checks.remediation: Persist idempotency keys and atomically bind side effects to event/audit records.

checks.title: Tenant-scoped policies
checks.remediation: Add tenant ownership or explicitly enforce a single-user deployment mode.

checks.title: Tenant-scoped templates
checks.remediation: Scope custom templates to an owner or tenant and preserve built-in templates separately.

checks.title: Backup and restore implementation
checks.remediation: Implement, version, encrypt, restore, and test a clean-machine backup workflow.

checks.title: Governed memory subsystem
checks.remediation: Implement provenance, correction, contradiction, expiry, deletion, and tenant isolation for memory.

checks.title: OpenTelemetry or equivalent structured telemetry
checks.remediation: Add traceable run, agent, model, tool, policy, cost, and verification events with privacy controls.

checks.title: SBOM and release provenance
checks.remediation: Generate and validate an SBOM, license report, model inventory, hashes, and build provenance.

checks.title: Drizzle ORM security baseline
checks.remediation: Upgrade to a non-vulnerable supported Drizzle ORM release and rerun tests/migrations.

checks.title: Registration hardening
checks.remediation: Add closed/invite/first-user registration modes, stronger password policy, and non-enumerating errors.

checks.title: External content trust boundary
checks.remediation: Label fetched data as untrusted and prevent it from granting authority or overriding policy.

checks.title: Explicit tool argument schemas
checks.remediation: Validate every tool input against a versioned schema before execution.

checks.title: English-only canonical package
checks.remediation: Keep the language gate in the release pipeline and re-run it after ZIP extraction.

checks.title: Measured model capability routing
checks.remediation: Route through measured hard constraints, deterministic utility scoring, fail-closed eligibility, and explicit fallback.

checks.title: Governed memory prompt boundary
checks.remediation: Quarantine instruction-like or sensitive memory and label selected records as evidence rather than authority.

checks.title: Tool capability and runtime budgets
checks.remediation: Enforce allowlists, risk scopes, timeouts, output ceilings, and explicit network/filesystem capabilities.

checks.title: Artifact idempotency receipt
checks.remediation: Bind artifact creation to a stable run/step/tool receipt and reuse the persisted result on duplicate delivery.

checks.title: Operator control dossier
checks.remediation: Expose model choice, governed context, authority, tool effects, recovery evidence, pressure, and SLO violations without generic success decoration.

checks.title: Serializable approval continuation contract
checks.remediation: Persist the contract behind approval waits and connect it to the active runner before claiming restart continuation.

checks.title: Adversarial generated state-space tests
checks.remediation: Keep generated cycle, routing permutation, and illegal lifecycle tests in the safe release suite.

checks.title: Lease fencing rejects stale workers
checks.remediation: Bind every durable mutation to a monotonically increasing fencing token and reject stale commits.

checks.title: Step-level durable workflow
checks.remediation: Persist and recover step progress rather than treating a whole agent run as one opaque durable action.

checks.title: Hash-bound independent verification
checks.remediation: Bind verifier decisions to immutable source, test, artifact, and release hashes and expose missing verification honestly.

checks.title: Approval compare-and-set revision
checks.remediation: Reject stale or duplicate cross-process approval decisions with a database compare-and-set revision.

checks.title: Risk-adjusted autonomy boundary
checks.remediation: Derive autonomy from risk, reversibility, idempotency, and evidence; never from prompt-granted authority.

checks.title: Pilot-readiness evidence gate
checks.remediation: Keep runtime calm separate from release readiness and classify unknown evidence conservatively.

checks.title: Six-mode dynamic Roast
checks.remediation: Run repeatable runtime, recovery, security, product, release, and performance audit modes.

checks.title: Targeted semantic mutation probes
checks.remediation: Prove the adversarial suite detects removal of selected critical guards and state the scope limit honestly.

checks.title: Verification-aware model routing
checks.remediation: Use measured verifier quality and model health as explicit routing signals and hard constraints.

checks.title: Governed-memory ablation evidence
checks.remediation: Compare no-memory, raw retrieval, and governed retrieval under poisoning and token pressure before claiming benefit.
